snapshot_policy: Each captured ledger was read as immutable bytes and hashed; capture is per-file, not an atomic global transaction. Later changes were not merged. Parent should rejoin changed active ledgers, without interpreting frozen pending entries as defects. One explicitly documented late overlay joins only M12 and C00 at the recorded later hashes; base arrays preserve their original observations and targeted_late_* fields carry the newer evidence.

normalization_rules.coordinates: 1-based inclusive lines for physical text; 0-based inclusive bytes where explicitly recorded; decoded loader lines never substitute for original binary byte coverage.
normalization_rules.union: Union every actual reviewer range, including M12 root and M12B; retain reviewer and primary ownership separately.
normalization_rules.completion: M02 status complete corroborated by report accepted despite absent boolean; root initial inventory markers are not current review results.
normalization_rules.semantics: Line coverage, hashes and titles cannot certify function/branch semantics. Named reviewer comparisons and links are preserved as evidence; GCV did not repeat whole source semantic review.
normalization_rules.partial: Support partial/missing is a finding outcome, not reading partial. Outside-owner not_reviewed is not a primary-owner gap.
normalization_rules.pending: Incomplete owner snapshots are pending; no missing assertion or representative-sampling substitution.
normalization_rules.original_reuse: Exact raw line-byte pairs + reviewed current scope; no same-name or fuzzy-equivalence assumption. Original inverse clause records also count as comparison records, not invented body-read intervals.
